comment: Owner of the list of user-facing CMake targets. README.md's Build section mirrors it; tools/list_cmake_targets.py --check fails when a listed target is missing from a configured tree. Targets not listed here are internal. Planned entries are recorded in 'planned' until they exist.

stage 01-c.what: offline preflight of the configured C stage (no fetch or build)
compile libc, libm, libdl, PAL, startup, shell, make
run the 01-c tests (skipped when the stage inputs are unchanged)
package, archive and verify out/<preset>/dist/01-c (skipped when unchanged)

stage 02-cxx.what: offline preflight of the complete imported C++ configuration
run the static/shared imported C++ runtime smokes (currently uncached)
package, archive and verify out/<preset>/dist/02-cxx (skipped when unchanged)

stage 03-gfx-simple.what: offline preflight of the complete window/input stage configuration
run the 03-gfx-simple tests (skipped when the stage inputs are unchanged)
package, archive and verify out/<preset>/dist/03-gfx-simple (skipped when unchanged)

stage 04-gfx-media.what: offline preflight of GPU, Skia, FFmpeg and curl configuration
compile Skia, GPU, FFmpeg, media, networking
run the 04-gfx-media tests (skipped when the stage inputs are unchanged)
package, archive and verify out/<preset>/dist/04-gfx-media (skipped when unchanged)

stage 05-ui.what: offline preflight of the complete cumulative LVGL UI configuration
run the 05-ui tests (skipped when the stage inputs are unchanged)
package, archive and verify out/<preset>/dist/05-ui (skipped when unchanged)

stage 06-web.what: produce a native 06-web SDK through the isolated driver, including its mandatory candidate validation
replay packaged browser, HTTP/TLS and Host ABI checks on a disposable SDK copy
test, verify and archive 06-web locally; no publication

ports.what: build and test every porting recipe

release.what: build and verify the dev profile, compare the Full runtime baseline, and prepare local tagged assets
prepare the cumulative 06-web Full SDK with existing security/source/release gates; no upload

maintenance.what: forget the recorded stage-cache state so the next build reruns every step

internal_stage_parts.crt-development-sdk-test: internal Development SDK HTTPS/inflate reference consumer gate

internal_os_scope.comment: Internal targets whose function is specific to one operating system but which CMake currently defines on every host (measured on the five CI hosts, 2026-10-22). They are not user-facing; do not run them on the other hosts. Narrowing their definition is tracked in TODO.md.
